description: Generative art with p5.js: an algorithmic philosophy first, then its expression as seeded, reproducible code in an interactive viewer with parameter exploration.
name: emberfield

security.reviewed_by: Ported and reviewed 2026-08-15: upstream code audited, trademarks removed, CDN reference pinned with subresource integrity, determinism proven by rendering.

tests.coverage: 14 tests: the viewer's control contract, the seeding law, provenance (licence and notice), template syntax, and pixel-identical headless rendering of the same seed twice against a hash-pinned p5.js

verifications.by: Port review (Claude Opus 5, on the maintainer's machine)
verifications.findings: Derivative of anthropics/skills algorithmic-art (Apache-2.0). Changes and non-claims are recorded in NOTICE.md.
verifications.method: Audited the upstream skill, rebuilt the viewer without upstream branding, pinned p5.js by SRI and SHA-256, and verified the seeding promise by rendering seed 12345 twice headlessly (identical hashes) and seed 512144 once (different hash).
